meta.purpose: Test coverage of Open Food Facts (and FatSecret where credentials exist) for real packaged products sold in the Russian market. NOT part of the NutriTrack application.
methodology: Products are common packaged SKUs from Russian supermarkets, biased toward Russian brands (Danone/Простоквашино, ВБД/Домик в деревне, ЭкоНива, Мираторг, Агуша, Чудо, Макфа, Добрый, Увелка, Красный Октябрь) plus international brands sold in Russia (Heinz RU-made and imported, Bonduelle RU-made, Barilla, Lay's RU-made, Coca-Cola, Pepsi).

Every barcode was taken from a public source INDEPENDENT of Open Food Facts (Russian retailer product pages, the Роскачество product registry, or a barcode catalog only as a last resort). Open Food Facts pages were never used to build this dataset, so coverage numbers are not circular.
Every barcode passed EAN-13 check-digit validation before being included.
No barcodes or products were invented; SKUs whose package size or barcode could not be verified were excluded (see meta.excluded).

verificationSourceTiers.retailer: official retailer product page (irmag.ru, vodovoz.ru, alania-market.ru, detmir.ru, barista-ltd.ru, tuttofood.pro, shop.sudzhuk.ru, mosprivoz.ru, parhato.ru, green-dostavka.by, lamberg.store, magnit.ru, dixy.ru)
verificationSourceTiers.quality-agency: Роскачество product registry (rskrf.ru) — state-affiliated quality agency publishing label data and barcodes
verificationSourceTiers.catalog: barcode catalog (ean13.info, goodsmatrix.ru, barcode-list.ru) — used only when no better source was available; treated as the weakest tier

excluded.reason: Barcode verified via rskrf.ru, but the exact package size of the tested SKU could not be confirmed from a public source, so exact SKU verification was impossible — excluded per stage rules.
Дикси lists a Hungarian-imported variant without a barcode; the included Bonduelle SKU (3083680002875) was instead verified via alania-market.ru + two catalogs.
